# 280 tests green, tsc clean. A green is a moment, not a state.
# HOW THE CODE SIDE WAS RESOLVED. Every colour below is the value the class

# The 24px action glyphs were checked against buttonVariants' [&_svg]:size-4,
# which compiles at specificity 0,1,1 and outranks a caller's size utility -
# it does not reach them, because those are plain `button` elements and not the

# `disabled:opacity-50` had to be answered.
# THE INSTRUMENT NOTE. `get_metadata` was not used for any value here; every
# number came off the Plugin API, which is the only reader that enumerates a
# node's fills, its NODE opacity and its text segments separately. That

column1: Create post - two images [10335-236021]
column5: MEASURED IN FULL AND NOT BUILT, BECAUSE BUILDING IT CHANGES A CONTRACT OTHER LANES READ. FIGMA `Frame 1265` is a HORIZONTAL auto-layout, gap 8, holding two tiles that each FILL half of it: at 1440 (`10335:236102`) 460 wide over two 226 x 198.798 tiles at cornerRadius 12, each with a 36 x 36 circular remove control filled #001615 at opacity 0.44 inset 16 from the top and right (`10335:236037`, `10335:236093`); at 375 (`11527:291915`) 330 wide over two 161 x 161 tiles at the same radius with 32 x 32 controls inset 8 (`11527:291917`, `11527:291919`). The column above them, `Frame 1262`, carries itemSpacing 24 at both. CODE the composer holds ONE `imageUrl` in state, renders one full-width preview, and submits `{content, imageUrl, cashtag}`; `socialFeedService.createPost` takes a single `image_url` (`:232`, `:256`, `:430`). So a second image has nowhere to go without widening `FeedPost.media`, `feedSource`'s mapping and `PostCard`'s reader, all of which other lanes read. TWO OPTIONS: (a) ship two-image posts end to end - carry the second URL in the `posts.metadata` jsonb the service already writes (`socialFeedService.ts:443`), widen `FeedPost.media` to a list, and render `Frame 1265` in both the composer and the card, which needs no schema change; or (b) rule the state out of the product and record `10335:236021` / `11527:291862` as a drawing we do not offer, so the pair stops reading as unbuilt work. NOT GUESSED EITHER WAY - a composer that accepts two files and posts one is the shape of defect this repo has been burned by.

Its `main` is 1382 wide at x=58, and inside it the header row `Frame 629` is 1202 at x=90, the story rail `Frame 1249` 702 at x=360 and the post column `Main container` 506 at x=438. STAYS PARTIAL FOR TWO THINGS, both measured and neither implemented, and the reasons are different. (1) THE RAIL IS 20 RIGHT OF CENTRE AT 1440 AND NOWHERE ELSE. Its centre is 711 against a `main` centre of 691, corroborated on `10430:98331` over `5194:271602`, which reads x=360 w=702 to the pixel; the post column below it IS centred. Wave 27 left this because it lacked the other two boards, and this pass took them: at 768 `Frame 1250` is x=0 w=708 in a 708 column and at 375 x=0 w=343 in a 343 column, i.e. flush at both, so the offset exists only at 1440. It is still not shipped, because two boards agreeing on a nudge the column beneath them does not take is as consistent with a drawing accident as with a spec, and reproducing it means a 20px shift no other element on the page has a reason for. Needs a ruling, not a class. (2) THE PAGE GUTTER AT 768. `Frame 1000003867` sits at x=30 in a 768 board (708 wide) and at x=16 in a 375 board (343 wide), so the gutter steps 16 -> 30; `DiscoverFeed` carries a flat `px-4` = 16. The 375 side matches exactly and the 768 side would be 14 short per side - BUT the resolved code value is NOT `px-4` alone: the page mounts inside `Layout` (no horizontal padding of its own, `Layout.tsx:92-107`) inside one of two App shells chosen by a feature flag, and one of them adds `lg:pl-[var(--sidebar-width,248px)]`. Reporting a delta here would state one side of a comparison, so it is recorded as unresolved rather than as a defect.
